r3.provider_failure: Groq construct auditor HTTP 429 tokens-per-day capacity before sealing and before candidate calls.

r4.causal_conclusion: The r4 workflow consumed most of one job's wall-clock budget in pre-score provider waiting/authoring, then GitHub cancelled the FULL scoring step about 8.5 minutes after it began. Because no scoring checkpoint or sanitized report was written, the exact number of already-scored hidden cases is unknown. Replaying the r4 pack from the start could create prohibited second attempts, so r4 is NOT_EXECUTABLE and its pack is disqualified from release scoring reuse.

authoring_remediation.representation_change: Reuse the r3/r4 deterministic 13-line tagged record unchanged. The outer r6 AUTHOR_SCHEMA, field count, field names, types and cardinality remain unchanged.
tagged_record_contract: Exactly 13 non-empty lines in the fixed order below.
HF=NONE or comma-separated frozen critical hard-fail identifiers
authoring_remediation.decoder_rule: Reuse the r3/r4 deterministic decoder unchanged.
authoring_remediation.fresh_attempt_rule: All r5 author attempts are fresh. No prior rejected payload and no r4 hidden pack/case may be inspected, repaired, replayed, paraphrased, ranked or reused.
authoring_remediation.safe_observability: Only preregistered structural reason codes, group names, attempt counts, audit reason codes, provider status class and call counts may be logged; never hidden values, case facts, raw author output or reconstructed hidden reference content.

provider_resilience_remediation.retry_delay_rule: Use Retry-After when present; otherwise parse the provider 'try again in' duration from the 429 body. Add a 5-second safety buffer.
provider_resilience_remediation.second_failure_rule: If the single delayed retry also fails, stop NOT_EXECUTABLE before sealing and before candidate calls.
provider_resilience_remediation.non_429_rule: All other provider transport failures keep the inherited infrastructure-failure behavior.

execution_split_remediation.trigger: r4 FULL scoring was cancelled by the per-job wall-clock after successful fresh authoring, sealing, preflight and canary.
execution_split_remediation.author_job: Fresh authoring, independent construct audit, immediate sealing, re-sealing with the frozen Gemini runner, static/sealed preflight, then upload of the exact encrypted scoring pack. No canary and no candidate scoring in this job.
execution_split_remediation.scoring_job: A separate dependent job downloads only the exact scoring artifact produced by the author job in the same workflow run, verifies artifact/run/candidate/pack bindings, performs static/sealed preflight and exact-runtime canary, then executes the preregistered FULL qualification exactly once and validates the sanitized report.
execution_split_remediation.artifact_boundary: The author job exports GitHub artifact id/digest plus internal sealed pack digest as job outputs; the scoring job must verify all three before any candidate call.

release_rule: Use the exact r1 FULL release contract with the unchanged tagged hidden-reference transport and Groq-429 resilience. R5 changes only job-level execution isolation. PASS still requires a COMPLETE fresh FULL report, at least 34/36 base tasks, every family at least 2/3, all six repeated critical trials passing and zero critical hard-fails.
